# Load data

```{r}
library(data.table)

match_sumstats_to_1000G_EUR <- function(
    sumstats_file,
    bfile,
    out_file
  ) {
    sumstats <- fread(sumstats_file)

    sumstats[, `:=`(
      chromosome = as.integer(chromosome),
      pos = as.integer(pos),
      chr_pos = paste0(chromosome, ":", pos)
    )]

    sumstats <- sumstats[complete.cases(sumstats)]

    bim <- fread(paste0(bfile, ".bim"), header = FALSE)
    setnames(bim, c("chromosome", "chr_pos", "cm", "pos", "a1", "a2"))

    matched <- sumstats[chr_pos %in% bim$chr_pos]

    fwrite(matched, out_file, sep = "\t")
}

match_sumstats_to_1000G_EUR(
    sumstats_file = sumstats_file,
    bfile = "ldref/1000G/EUR.chrpos",
    out_file = "height_matched_to_1000GEUR.sumstats"
)

```

```{r}
sumstats_clean <- read.table("height_matched_to_1000GEUR.sumstats", header = TRUE)
```

```{r}
hat_beta_g_set <- sumstats_clean$direct_Beta
hat_delta_g_set <- sumstats_clean$avg_NTC_Beta
se_beta_set <-  sumstats_clean$direct_SE
se_delta_set <- sumstats_clean$avg_NTC_SE
corr_set <- sumstats_clean$r_direct_avg_NTC
G <- length(hat_beta_g_set)
```

```{r}
result <- GNmix_diffvar(hat_delta_g_set, se_delta_set, u = 300)
save(result, file = "results/result.RData")
value <- as.matrix(result$u)
probability <- result$fu
```


```{r}
parametric_prior <-estimate_parametric_mle(hat_delta_g_set,se_delta_set)
```


Running the following chunk generates the data for Figures 2 and S3 and saves it to
the following CSV files under `results/`.

- `gwas_bias_se_pt.csv`
- `gwas_npmle_pt.csv`
- `gwas_param_pt.csv`
- `height_gwas_bias_nuisance_diagnostics.csv`

```{r}
#| label: export-gwas-csv

stopifnot(
  all(is.finite(c(hat_delta_g_set, se_delta_set, corr_set, se_beta_set))),
  all(se_delta_set > 0), all(se_beta_set > 0),
  length(value) > 0L, length(value) == length(probability),
  all(is.finite(value)), all(is.finite(probability)),
  all(probability >= 0), is.finite(sum(probability)), sum(probability) > 0,
  is.finite(parametric_prior$hat_mu_b),
  is.finite(parametric_prior$hat_var_b), parametric_prior$hat_var_b >= 0
)

csv_exports <- list(
  gwas_bias_se_pt.csv = data.frame(
    bias = hat_delta_g_set,
    bias_sd = se_delta_set
  ),
  gwas_npmle_pt.csv = data.frame(
    atom = as.numeric(value),
    weight = as.numeric(probability) / sum(probability)
  ),
  gwas_param_pt.csv = data.frame(
    hat_mu_b = parametric_prior$hat_mu_b,
    hat_var_b = parametric_prior$hat_var_b
  ),
  height_gwas_bias_nuisance_diagnostics.csv = data.frame(
    bias_hat = hat_delta_g_set,
    rho = corr_set,
    tau2 = se_delta_set^2,
    sigma2 = se_beta_set^2
  )
)

for (filename in names(csv_exports)) {
  output_file <- file.path("results", filename)
  write.csv(csv_exports[[filename]], output_file, row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
  message("Saved ", nrow(csv_exports[[filename]]), " rows to ", output_file)
}
```

```{r}
p_set <- numeric(G)
p_set_param <- numeric(G)
p_set_z <- numeric(G)
for(i in 1:G){
  p_value <- cal_p_value_npmle_diffvar(value,probability,hat_beta_g_set[i],hat_delta_g_set[i],se_beta_set[i],se_delta_set[i],corr_set[i])
  p_set[i] <-  p_value
  
  
  p_value_param <- cal_p_value_param_diffvar(parametric_prior$hat_mu_b,parametric_prior$hat_var_b,hat_beta_g_set[i],hat_delta_g_set[i],se_beta_set[i],se_delta_set[i],corr_set[i])
  p_set_param[i] <-  p_value_param
  
  p_value_z <- cal_p_value_z_diffvar(hat_beta_g_set[i],se_beta_set[i])
  p_set_z[i] <- p_value_z
}

p_set_pop_z <- numeric(G)
for(i in 1:G){  
  p_value_pop_z <- cal_p_value_z_diffvar(sumstats_clean$population_Beta[i],sumstats_clean$population_SE[i])
  p_set_pop_z[i] <- p_value_pop_z
}
```


```{r}
significance <- BH_adjust(p_set,alpha = 0.05)
significance_param <- BH_adjust(p_set_param,alpha = 0.05)
significance_z <- BH_adjust(p_set_z,alpha = 0.05)
significance_pop_z <- BH_adjust(p_set_pop_z,alpha = 0.05)

discovery_threshold <- function(p, flag) {
  if (any(flag)) max(p[flag]) else NA_real_
}
bh_threshold <- discovery_threshold(p_set, significance)
bh_threshold_param <- discovery_threshold(p_set_param, significance_param)
bh_threshold_z <- discovery_threshold(p_set_z, significance_z)
bh_threshold_pop_z <- discovery_threshold(p_set_pop_z, significance_pop_z)
```


```{r}
print(sum(significance))
print(sum(significance_param))
print(sum(significance_z))
print(sum(significance_pop_z))
print(bh_threshold)
print(bh_threshold_param)
print(bh_threshold_z)
print(bh_threshold_pop_z)
```


# summarize discoveries

```{r}
bh_out_dir <- file.path("results/discovery_sets_bh", "bh")
bh_snp_dir <- file.path(bh_out_dir, "snp_ids")
bh_chr_pos_dir <- file.path(bh_out_dir, "chromosome_position")

dir.create(bh_snp_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(bh_chr_pos_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

write_bh_discovery_files <- function(flag, snp_file, chr_pos_file) {
  discovery_rows <- sumstats_clean[flag, ]
  
  write.table(
    data.frame(SNP = discovery_rows$SNP),
    file = file.path(bh_snp_dir, snp_file),
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  write.table(
    data.frame(
      chromosome = discovery_rows$chromosome,
      pos = discovery_rows$pos
    ),
    file = file.path(bh_chr_pos_dir, chr_pos_file),
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  data.frame(
    file_prefix = sub("_discoveries_snp_ids\\.txt$", "", snp_file),
    n_discoveries = nrow(discovery_rows),
    n_rsids = sum(grepl("^rs", discovery_rows$SNP)),
    n_non_rsids = sum(!grepl("^rs", discovery_rows$SNP))
  )
}

bh_discovery_summary <- rbind(
  write_bh_discovery_files(
    significance,
    "npmle_discoveries_snp_ids.txt",
    "npmle_discoveries_chr_pos.txt"
  ),
  write_bh_discovery_files(
    significance_param,
    "parametric_discoveries_snp_ids.txt",
    "parametric_discoveries_chr_pos.txt"
  ),
  write_bh_discovery_files(
    significance_z,
    "z_test_discoveries_snp_ids.txt",
    "z_test_discoveries_chr_pos.txt"
  ),
  write_bh_discovery_files(
    significance_pop_z,
    "population_z_test_discoveries_snp_ids.txt",
    "population_z_test_discoveries_chr_pos.txt"
  )
)

bh_discovery_summary$bh_threshold <- c(
  bh_threshold,
  bh_threshold_param,
  bh_threshold_z,
  bh_threshold_pop_z
)

bh_discovery_summary
```



## Manhattan plot
```{r}
manhattan_base_df <- data.frame(
  chromosome = as.integer(sumstats_clean$chromosome),
  pos = as.numeric(sumstats_clean$pos),
  SNP = sumstats_clean$SNP
)

manhattan_base_df <- manhattan_base_df[order(manhattan_base_df$chromosome, manhattan_base_df$pos), ]

chromosome_offsets <- aggregate(pos ~ chromosome, manhattan_base_df, max)
chromosome_offsets <- chromosome_offsets[order(chromosome_offsets$chromosome), ]
chromosome_offsets$offset <- c(0, cumsum(head(chromosome_offsets$pos, -1)))

manhattan_base_df <- merge(
  manhattan_base_df,
  chromosome_offsets[, c("chromosome", "offset")],
  by = "chromosome"
)
manhattan_base_df$genome_pos <- manhattan_base_df$pos + manhattan_base_df$offset

chromosome_axis_df <- aggregate(genome_pos ~ chromosome, manhattan_base_df, function(x) mean(range(x)))

manhattan_p_values <- data.frame(
  chromosome = rep(as.integer(sumstats_clean$chromosome), 4),
  pos = rep(as.numeric(sumstats_clean$pos), 4),
  SNP = rep(sumstats_clean$SNP, 4),
  p_value = c(p_set_param, p_set, p_set_z, p_set_pop_z),
  method = factor(
    rep(c("RB-Normal", "RB-NPMLE", "Direct-effect", "Population-effect"), each = length(p_set)),
    levels = c("RB-Normal", "RB-NPMLE", "Direct-effect", "Population-effect")
  )
)

manhattan_df <- merge(
  manhattan_p_values,
  manhattan_base_df[, c("chromosome", "pos", "SNP", "genome_pos")],
  by = c("chromosome", "pos", "SNP")
)
manhattan_p_floor <- 1e-50
manhattan_df$plot_p_value <- pmax(manhattan_df$p_value, manhattan_p_floor)
manhattan_df$minus_log10_p <- -log10(manhattan_df$plot_p_value)
bh_threshold_df <- data.frame(
  method = factor(
    c("RB-Normal", "RB-NPMLE", "Direct-effect", "Population-effect"),
    levels = c("RB-Normal", "RB-NPMLE", "Direct-effect", "Population-effect")
  ),
  bh_threshold = c(bh_threshold_param, bh_threshold, bh_threshold_z, bh_threshold_pop_z)
)
manhattan_df <- merge(manhattan_df, bh_threshold_df, by = "method")
manhattan_df$plot_color <- ifelse(
  !is.na(manhattan_df$bh_threshold) &
    manhattan_df$p_value <= manhattan_df$bh_threshold,
  as.character(manhattan_df$method),
  "Not significant"
)

plot_manhattan <- ggplot(manhattan_df, aes(x = genome_pos, y = minus_log10_p, color = plot_color)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.65) +
#   geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(5e-8), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey35", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = -log10(bh_threshold)), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.4, na.rm = TRUE) +
  facet_grid(method ~ .) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = "grey85",
      "RB-NPMLE" = "#377eb8",
      "RB-Normal" = "#e41a1c",
      "Direct-effect" = "#ff7f00",
      "Population-effect" = "#984ea3"
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = chromosome_axis_df$genome_pos,
    labels = chromosome_axis_df$chromosome,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Chromosome",
    y = expression(-log[10](italic(p)))
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", angle = 0, size = 18),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 11, angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)
  )

print(plot_manhattan)
ggsave('manhattan-stacked.png', plot_manhattan, width = 11.5, height = 7)
# ggsave('manhattan-stacked.pdf', plot_manhattan, width = 11.5, height = 7)
```
